note: policy_name is the single policy naive/hybrid RAG are told to search — for multi_part questions this is deliberately just the first relevant policy, so the eval also shows naive/hybrid missing the other half of the answer, not just agentic winning on style points. expected_keywords are used for the offline accuracy grader in run_eval.py (fraction of these terms found, case-insensitive, in the returned answer).
